inputImages.role: 큰 버튼과 양옆 게이지를 유지하며 눈금을 제거할 자체 생성 편집 대상

request: 게이지 눈금을 없애고 변형 시안 6개를 만든다.
invariants: 버튼마다 사용자를 향하는 구멍 하나, 싱글 연파랑·더블 금색

variants.title: 날렵한 교차형
variants.keywords: 가늘어진 외장 · 긴 사선 · 낮은 받침
variants.description: 교차하는 장갑을 가늘고 길게 정리하고, 하단 모서리를 낮게 연결했습니다.
variants.direction: Make an elegant slim version of the crossed-armor design. Narrow the silver outer shells by roughly one quarter, lengthen their clean tapered tips and use a precise long diagonal seam at mid-height with a thin recessed gold tongue. Slim the outer lower corners into a long tapered connection to a LOW dark bottom beam. Keep the wide gauges and large button faces unchanged in prominence. Four buttons have thin clean silver bevels; the four forward exhausts use a single restrained round rim. The outer silhouette should be slender and fluid with large uninterrupted silver planes.
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Create ONE distinct design variation of the attached rhythm-game frame. The attached image is the design to vary, not a composition sheet. One complete frame, portrait 2:3, front-on, fully visible with a small margin on charcoal, no extra views or labels.

MANDATORY CORRECTION ON BOTH GAUGES: REMOVE EVERY SCALE MARK from the source. The white horizontal dashes next to the cyan gauges must disappear completely. No ticks, graduations, segmented fills, stripes, notches, repeated marker dots, numerals or small periodic highlights on or beside either gauge. Both gauge borders must be long smooth uninterrupted metal edges. Show only a plain dark track with ONE continuous pale-cyan filled region at the same illustrative level on both sides, and a plain dark unfilled region above it. The single horizontal boundary between filled and unfilled regions is allowed; measurement marks are not. Keep each gauge wide and tall, roughly as wide and long as the source, alongside the straight inner edge of its pillar.

KEEP the design lineage: angular silver armor with a strong diagonal overlap on each side, deep blue-black structure, restrained metallic gold interlocks, clean polished 2D mechanical illustration with cel-shaded planes and selective metal highlights. Open top, no top bridge. Four equal dark lanes separated by exactly three subtle vertical lines. Preserve the generous central playable area.
KEEP the prominent bottom BUTTON DECK: exactly FOUR large distinct pressable dark slate-blue rectangular keycaps, one aligned with each lane, visible faces approximately 80-100 pixels high at 1024x1536, silver bevel and dark travel gap. These are clearly buttons, not tiny top strips. Below each keycap is exactly ONE separate fixed front-facing exhaust aperture. Exactly four apertures total, one per key. First and fourth off, second cyan and third warm gold; cyan and gold are one identical plume shape with only hue changed, pointing toward the viewer, no downward jet and no twin cores. Keycap design, rim, aperture shape and spacing are consistent across all four units within this variant.
Make a real, visible variation of the overall armor silhouette AND its connection to the button deck using the direction below; do not merely change lighting or recolor. Maintain the same gauge size, layout, palette and mechanical functions across variants so we can compare the form.
No characters, humanoid anatomy, faces, wings, spikes, weapons, text, logos, labels, ornaments, random extra lights or new controls. No tiny repetitive greebles. Most important: ZERO gauge ticks or scale markings anywhere.

VARIANT DIRECTION:
Make an elegant slim version of the crossed-armor design. Narrow the silver outer shells by roughly one quarter, lengthen their clean tapered tips and use a precise long diagonal seam at mid-height with a thin recessed gold tongue. Slim the outer lower corners into a long tapered connection to a LOW dark bottom beam. Keep the wide gauges and large button faces unchanged in prominence. Four buttons have thin clean silver bevels; the four forward exhausts use a single restrained round rim. The outer silhouette should be slender and fluid with large uninterrupted silver planes.
Final check: both tall broad gauge windows and BOTH adjacent borders are completely free of tick marks, dash marks and scale indicators.

Emphasize thickness, depth and clear large blocks without obstructing or shortening either smooth unmarked gauge.

The large four keys remain distinctly raised above four single forward-facing apertures, all housed together in a shallow shared base.
